zh.title: 修复新版提示缓存
zh.summary: 避免旧的检查结果持续阻止新版提示。

items.text: 更新检查结果最多缓存五分钟；重新进入关于页时再次检查，过期后重新验证线上版本信息。

en.title: Fix cached update checks
en.summary: Prevents stale check results from indefinitely hiding new releases.

items.text: Update checks are cached for at most five minutes. Reopening About checks again and revalidates online version information after the cache expires.

zh.title: 彩虹规划与天空盘
zh.summary: 新增彩虹规划和天空盘，完善日月银河观测、时间联动与移动端体验。

items.text: 新增彩虹规划，结合降雨、阳光与地形分析彩虹条件和视线风险；结果仅供参考，不保证可见。
新增事件天空盘与银心升落方位线，展示天体方向并联动观测时间。
统一日期、当地时间与事件选择，优化即将发生事件的高亮、观测窗口和预报联动。
精简云层控件，收起面板后保留规划参考线，并记忆显示设置。
支持隐藏地点搜索，优化手机与桌面布局，补齐中英文使用说明和首次语言选择。
修正当地日期边界和银河计算时间参数，优化预报加载、页面切换与重复计算。

en.title: Rainbow planning and sky views
en.summary: Adds rainbow planning and sky views, with improved celestial planning, time controls and mobile layouts.

items.text: Adds rainbow planning using rain, sunlight and terrain evidence to assess conditions and sightline risks. Estimates do not guarantee visibility.
Adds event sky views and galactic-center rise/set direction lines linked to the observation time.
Unifies dates, local time and event selection, with clearer upcoming-event highlights, observing windows and forecast updates.
Simplifies cloud controls, retains planning reference lines when collapsed and remembers display settings.
Adds a hide control for location search, refines mobile and desktop layouts, and expands bilingual guidance and first-use language selection.
Corrects local date boundaries and galactic time parameters, and improves forecast loading, panel transitions and repeated calculations.
